section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种人工智能机器学习的数据采集装置，包括底座外壳和外包外壳，所述底座外壳的左右两端均固定连接有外包边角，所述外包外壳的前端左右两端均活动连接有角铁，所述角铁的内部安装有锁紧螺丝，所述外包外壳的后端固定连接有合页，所述翻盖外壳的左右两端内部均设有抓槽，所述提拉把手的左侧开设有散热孔，所述外包外壳的上端设有定位边框。该人工智能机器学习的数据采集装置，增加结构的同时大大提高了整个装置的实用性能，改良后的数据采集装置采用拼接组合式外壳结构，便于使用者对内部结构的维护和更换操作，并且该数据采集装置外部增加了防护结构，同时该装置可以分别对图像和语音信息进行收集学习。

The utility model discloses a data acquisition device of artificial intelligence machine learning, including base shell and outsourcing shell, the equal fixedly connected with outsourcing corner in both ends about base shell, the equal swing joint in both ends has the angle bar about outsourcing shell's front end, the internally mounted of angle bar has locking screw, outsourcing shell's rear end fixedly connected with hinge, the inside groove of grabbing that all is equipped with in both ends about flip shell, carry the left side of carrying the handle and seted up the louvre, outsourcing shell's upper end is equipped with the location frame. This artificial intelligence machine learning's data acquisition device has improved the practicality of whole device greatly when increasing the structure, and data acquisition device after the improvement adopts concatenation combination formula shell structure, and convenient to use person is to the maintenance and the change operation of inner structure to this data acquisition device outside has increased protective structure, and the device can collect the study to image and speech information respectively simultaneously.

Data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learningTechnical Field

The utility model relates to an artificial intelligence learning equipment technical field specifically is an artificial intelligence machine learning's data acquisition device.

Background

Artificial intelligence, also known as intelligent mechanical and machine intelligence, refers to the intelligence exhibited by machines manufactured by humans; artificial intelligence generally refers to a technique for presenting human intelligence through a common computer program; the word also indicates whether and how to study such intelligent systems; the definition field of artificial intelligence in general textbooks is 'research and design of intelligent agent', and the intelligent agent refers to a system which can observe the surrounding environment and act to reach the target; the research of artificial intelligence is highly technical and professional, and all branch fields are deep and are not communicated, so the related range is very wide; the data acquisition means that non-electric quantity or electric quantity signals are automatically acquired from analog and digital tested units such as sensors and other devices to be tested and are sent to an upper computer for analysis and processing; the data acquisition system is a flexible and user-defined measurement system implemented in conjunction with computer-based or other specialized test platform-based measurement software and hardware products.

The existing data acquisition device is mostly in an integrated structure with an intelligent machine, the device is difficult to maintain and replace the inside in the long-time use process, the external structure of the device is inconvenient for users to detach and install, and the information does not have an independent storage space, so that the data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning is provided.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

An object of the utility model is to provide a data acquisition device of artificial intelligence machine learning to solve the data acquisition device that proposes in the above-mentioned background art and adopt mostly with intelligent machine integral structure, its device is difficult to maintain the change to inside in long-time use, and its exterior structure is not convenient for user's dismantlement installation, and does not have independent storage space scheduling problem to information.

In order to achieve the above object, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: a data acquisition device for artificial intelligent machine learning comprises a base shell and an outer shell, wherein the left end and the right end of the base shell are fixedly connected with outer shell corners, fixing rivets are arranged inside the outer shell corners, the left end and the right end of the front end of the outer shell are movably connected with angle irons, the outer shell is positioned above the base shell, locking screws are arranged inside the angle irons, hinges are fixedly connected with the rear end of the outer shell, the upper end of each hinge is fixedly connected with a flip shell, grabbing grooves are arranged inside the left end and the right end of the flip shell, a lifting handle is movably connected inside the upper end of the flip shell, heat dissipation holes are formed in the left side of the lifting handle, a positioning frame is arranged at the upper end of the outer shell, a camera is arranged at the front end of the outer shell, a voice receiving device is arranged on the right side of the camera, and a loudspeaker is arranged on the left side of the camera, the inside of outsourcing shell is equipped with battery and information storage device respectively, and the battery is located information storage device's rear.

Preferably, the outsourcing corners are symmetrical with each other about a vertical central line of the base shell, and are connected with the base shell through fixing rivets.

Preferably, the angle irons are symmetrical with respect to a vertical central line of the outer casing, and the angle irons are connected with the outer casing through locking screws.

Preferably, the rear end of the flip housing is connected with the rear end of the outer casing through a hinge, and the flip housing forms a rotating structure through the hinge.

Preferably, the grabbing groove is embedded in the flip shell, and the inner size structure of the lower end of the flip shell is matched with the outer size structure of the positioning frame.

Preferably, the output of camera is connected with information storage device, and voice receiver's output is connected with information storage device, the output of battery is connected with information storage device, and information storage device's output is connected with the speaker.

Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows:

1. the utility model discloses in rely on the cooperation between base shell and the outsourcing shell can constitute the whole external frame structure of the device to this protects sealed to interior equipment, and the outside edge of base shell and flip shell all fixedly connected with outsourcing corner, thereby realizes the guard action to the outside of the device, wherein the outsourcing shell can be connected with intelligent machine through the cooperation between angle bar and the screw, makes the device be independent mounting structure;

2. the connection mode between the middle angle iron and the outer package shell of the utility model is simple and convenient to operate, and the flip shell can be opened through the rotation of the hinge, so that the maintenance and the replacement operation of the inside are convenient for the user, wherein the vertical central line of the flip shell can be kept coincident with the vertical central lines of the outer package shell and the base shell by the positioning frame, thereby keeping the integrity of the shell of the device;

3. the utility model discloses in rely on camera and pronunciation receiving arrangement respectively can carry out receiving operation to external image information and speech information, wherein the model of camera is JHEM500 GC; the model of the voice receiving device is WX-12-2-382478; the image information and the voice information obtained in the above way can be stored in the information storage device.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be described clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present invention, not all embodiments. Based on the embodiments in the present invention, all other embodiments obtained by a person skilled in the art without creative work belong to the protection scope of the present invention.

Referring to fig. 1-4, the present invention provides a technical solution: a data acquisition device for artificial intelligent machine learning comprises a base shell 1 and an outer shell 4, wherein the left end and the right end of the base shell 1 are fixedly connected with outer shell corners 2, fixing rivets 3 are arranged inside the outer shell corners 2, the outer shell corners 2 are symmetrical with respect to a vertical central line of the base shell 1, the outer shell corners 2 are connected with the base shell 1 through the fixing rivets 3, the left end and the right end of the front end of the outer shell 4 are movably connected with angle irons 5, the outer shell 4 is positioned above the base shell 1, the angle irons 5 are symmetrical with respect to the vertical central line of the outer shell 4, the angle irons 5 are connected with the outer shell 4 through locking screws 6, an integral external frame structure of the device can be formed by matching the base shell 1 and the outer shell 4, internal equipment is protected and sealed, and the outer corners of the base shell 1 and a flip shell 8 are fixedly connected with the outer shell corners 2, thereby realizing the protection function to the outside of the device, wherein the outer casing 4 can be connected with the intelligent machine through the matching between the angle iron 5 and the screw, so that the device is an independent installation structure;

the internally mounted of angle bar 5 has locking screw 6, the rear end fixedly connected with hinge 7 of outsourcing shell 4, and the upper end fixedly connected with flip shell 8 of hinge 7, flip shell 8's rear end is connected with the rear end of outsourcing shell 4 through hinge 7, and flip shell 8 constitutes revolution mechanic through hinge 7, flip shell 8 all is equipped with grabs groove 9 about both ends, and flip shell 8's the inside swing joint in upper end has and carries handle 10, it inlays in flip shell 8's inside to grab groove 9, and flip shell 8's lower extreme inner dimension structure is identical with the outside dimension structure of location frame 12, the connected mode between angle bar 5 and the outsourcing shell 4 operates comparatively simply and conveniently, and flip shell 8 can open through the hinge 7 is rotatory, convenient to the maintenance change operation of inside, wherein rely on location frame 12 can keep between the vertical central line of flip shell 8 and the vertical central line of outsourcing shell 4 and base shell 1's vertical central line Overlap to maintain the integrity of the device housing;

a heat dissipation hole 11 is formed in the left side of the lifting handle 10, a positioning frame 12 is arranged at the upper end of the outer packaging shell 4, a camera 13 is arranged at the front end of the outer packaging shell 4, a voice receiving device 14 is arranged on the right side of the camera 13, a loudspeaker 15 is arranged on the left side of the camera 13, a storage battery 16 and an information storage device 17 are respectively arranged inside the outer packaging shell 4, the storage battery 16 is positioned behind the information storage device 17, the output end of the camera 13 is connected with the information storage device 17, the output end of the voice receiving device 14 is connected with the information storage device 17, the output end of the storage battery 16 is connected with the information storage device 17, the output end of the information storage device 17 is connected with the loudspeaker 15, external image information and voice information can be received by means of the camera 13 and the voice receiving device 14, and the model of the camera 13 is JHEM500 GC; the voice receiving apparatus 14 is of a model WX-12-2-382478; the image information and the voice information obtained as described above can be stored in the information storage device 17.

The working principle is as follows: for the data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning, firstly, the whole external frame structure of the device can be formed by the cooperation between the base shell 1 and the external shell 4, so as to protect and seal the internal equipment, and the external corners of the base shell 1 and the flip shell 8 are fixedly connected with the external corners 2, so as to protect the outside of the device, wherein the external shell 4 can be connected with the intelligent machine by the cooperation between the angle iron 5 and the screw, so that the device is an independent installation structure, the connection mode between the angle iron 5 and the external shell 4 is simpler and more convenient to operate, the flip shell 8 can be opened by the rotation of the hinge 7, thereby facilitating the maintenance and replacement operation of the inside by a user, wherein, the vertical central line of the flip shell 8 can be kept coincident with the vertical central lines of the external shell 4 and the base shell 1 by the positioning frame 12, therefore, the integrity of the shell of the device is kept, and the camera 13 and the voice receiving device 14 can respectively receive external image information and voice information, wherein the model of the camera 13 is JHEM500 GC; the voice receiving apparatus 14 is of a model WX-12-2-382478; the image information and the voice information obtained as described above can be stored in the information storage device 17.

Although embodiments of the present invention have been shown and described, it will be appreciated by those skilled in the art that changes, modifications, substitutions and alterations can be made in these embodiments without departing from the principles and spirit of the invention, the scope of which is defined in the appended claims and their equivalents.
